package.name: user_interface
package.description:
A package to hold all code relating to the UI for DaVE
This design will have the UI be a C++ program that will run without any ROS2 functionality In a second thread, we will run a ros 2 node that will facilitate communication between our UI and the Rover
This separation is so that the timing of of each from as well as the timing related to ros 2 topic publication/subscription do not affect each other.
